emptyStateDescription: No Windows tweaks were found for your system configuration.
timerTweaksDescription: Optimize Windows timer resolution and CPU scheduling for competitive gaming. Requires reboot to take effect.
timerLoadFailed: Could not read the timer state.
hpetDescription: Disable platform clock for lower timer latency on Intel CPUs. May help on AMD Ryzen too.
tscSyncDescription: Legacy = lower input lag, slightly less FPS. Enhanced = more FPS, slightly more input lag.
dynamicTickDescription: Prevents Windows from suspending the system timer tick in idle. Reduces micro-stutters.
autoTuningDescription: Reduces bufferbloat and jitter during gaming. Recommended for competitive gaming. May slow large downloads.
advancedToolsDescription: These adjust the internal behaviour of the Windows network stack and timer. They are not needed for everyday use: apply only if you know what you are changing, and revert whenever they cause problems.
dnsDescription: A resolver answers faster when it resolves a name faster, which makes pages and API responses arrive sooner. Test to find out which one is best for your connection.
dnsManualHint: You can use any of the options. Testing only sorts the list by speed.
dnsPartialFailure: Some servers did not answer within the timeout and are listed last.
tcpIpDescription: Adjusts chimney, timestamps and the initial retransmission timeout (RTO) of the TCP stack. It lowers latency in general use, but turns off features that help on unstable networks.
timerCaution: Microsoft documents HPET, TSC Sync Policy and Dynamic Tick as debugging options. They can destabilise some systems: if you notice stutter, revert them.
loadFailedDescription: The system scan failed. Please try again.
dnsPresetsFailed: Could not load the DNS presets.
dnsBenchmarkFailed: Could not measure the speed of the DNS servers.

toggle-keys-off.name: Toggle Keys — OFF
toggle-keys-off.description: Disables Toggle Keys (sound alert when locking keys)

filter-keys-off.name: Filter Keys — OFF
filter-keys-off.description: Disables Filter Keys (ignores quickly repeated keys)

menu-show-delay.name: Menu Show Delay — 0ms
menu-show-delay.description: Removes the menu opening delay in Windows

widgets-off.name: Widgets (Win11) — OFF
widgets-off.description: Removes the Widgets button from the taskbar (Win11)

news-interest-off.name: News & Interests — OFF
news-interest-off.description: Removes News and Interests from the taskbar

start-suggested-content-off.name: Suggested Content in Start — OFF
start-suggested-content-off.description: Removes suggested content from the Start menu

recent-files-off.name: Recent Files in Start — OFF
recent-files-off.description: Removes recent files from the Start menu

lock-screen-ads-off.name: Lock Screen Ads — OFF
lock-screen-ads-off.description: Disables ads and tips on the lock screen

background-apps.name: Background Apps — OFF
background-apps.description: Disables apps running in the background

mouse-threshold1.name: Mouse Threshold 1 — Zero
mouse-threshold1.description: Sets the mouse acceleration threshold to zero

mouse-threshold2.name: Mouse Threshold 2 — Zero
mouse-threshold2.description: Sets the secondary mouse acceleration threshold to zero

mouse-hover-time.name: Mouse Hover Time — 0ms
mouse-hover-time.description: Removes the mouse hover and tooltip delay

mpo-overlay-minfps.name: MPO Overlay Min FPS — 0
mpo-overlay-minfps.description: Removes the minimum FPS for MPO overlays (experimental)

vsync-global-off.name: VSync Global — OFF
vsync-global-off.description: Forces VSync off globally for DirectX games

hw-accel-wpf.name: HW Acceleration WPF — ON
hw-accel-wpf.description: Enables hardware acceleration in WPF apps (more performance)

gpu-tdr-delay.name: GPU TDR Delay — 8s
gpu-tdr-delay.description: Raises the GPU recovery timeout to 8s (avoids crashes)

mmcss-gpu-priority.name: MMCSS GPU Priority — 8
mmcss-gpu-priority.description: GPU priority in games through MMCSS

mmcss-priority.name: MMCSS CPU Priority — 6
mmcss-priority.description: CPU priority in games through MMCSS

mmcss-background.name: MMCSS Background Only — False
mmcss-background.description: Stops games from being treated as a background task

mmcss-affinity.name: MMCSS Affinity — 0 (all cores)
mmcss-affinity.description: Lets games use all CPU cores

mmcss-clock-rate.name: MMCSS Clock Rate — 10000 (1ms)
mmcss-clock-rate.description: 1ms clock rate for games (more precise timer)

mmcss-nolazymode.name: MMCSS NoLazyMode — ON
mmcss-nolazymode.description: Disables MMCSS lazy mode (game threads never sleep)

power-throttling-off.name: Power Throttling — OFF
power-throttling-off.description: Disables Windows power throttling for processes

hibernate-off.name: Hibernation — OFF
hibernate-off.description: Disables hibernation and deletes the hiberfil.sys file

pcie-aspm-off.name: PCIe ASPM — OFF
pcie-aspm-off.description: Disables PCIe power saving (GPU and NVMe always active)

usb-selective-suspend-off.name: USB Selective Suspend — OFF
usb-selective-suspend-off.description: Disables selective suspend for USB devices

processor-min-max.name: CPU Min/Max — 100%
processor-min-max.description: Pins the CPU to a 100% minimum and maximum (removes power saving)

gamedvr-fse.name: Game DVR FSE Behavior — 2
gamedvr-fse.description: Enables exclusive fullscreen mode for games

gamedvr-honor-fse.name: Game DVR Honor FSE — 1
gamedvr-honor-fse.description: Respects the user's exclusive fullscreen choice

gamedvr-dxgi.name: Game DVR DXGI FSE — 1
gamedvr-dxgi.description: Allows DXGI in exclusive fullscreen mode

auto-game-mode.name: Auto Game Mode — ON
auto-game-mode.description: Enables the Windows automatic Game Mode

perfopt-csgo.name: CPU Priority — CS2 (High)
perfopt-csgo.description: Forces High priority for the CS2.exe process

perfopt-fivem.name: CPU Priority — FiveM (High)
perfopt-fivem.description: Forces High priority for the FiveM.exe process

win32-priority-sep.name: Win32 Priority Separation — 38
win32-priority-sep.description: Adjusts priority separation for better gaming performance

system-responsiveness.name: System Responsiveness — 0
system-responsiveness.description: Removes the CPU reservation for background tasks

disable-paging-exec.name: Disable Paging Executive — 1
disable-paging-exec.description: Keeps kernel drivers resident in RAM (no swap to disk)

svchost-threshold.name: SvcHost Split Threshold — 64MB
svchost-threshold.description: Raises the service split threshold to 64MB

ntfs-last-access-off.name: NTFS Last Access Update — OFF
ntfs-last-access-off.description: Disables the NTFS last access date update

wait-to-kill-timeout.name: WaitToKillServiceTimeout — 2000ms
wait-to-kill-timeout.description: Shortens the service shutdown timeout to 2s (faster shutdown)

pool-usage-maximum.name: PoolUsageMaximum — 80%
pool-usage-maximum.description: Raises the kernel pool to 80% (more drivers in RAM, less swap)

large-system-cache.name: LargeSystemCache — ON
large-system-cache.description: Enables the large system cache (more assets in RAM)

hid-power-management.name: HID Power Save — OFF
hid-power-management.description: Disables power saving for USB mouse and keyboard

ntfs-8dot3-disable.name: NTFS 8.3 Names — OFF
ntfs-8dot3-disable.description: Disables 8.3 name creation on NTFS (less I/O)

ntfs-mft-zone.name: NTFS MFT Zone — 400MB
ntfs-mft-zone.description: Raises the MFT reservation to 400MB (less fragmentation)

tcp-no-delay.name: TCP No Delay — ON
tcp-no-delay.description: Disables the Nagle algorithm (immediate TCP packet sending)

tcp-ack-freq.name: TCP Ack Frequency — 1
tcp-ack-freq.description: Reduces ACKs to 1 per packet (lower network latency)

tcp-no-delay-iface.name: TCP No Delay (Interfaces)
tcp-no-delay-iface.description: Disables Nagle on each network interface individually

default-ttl.name: Default TTL — 64
default-ttl.description: Sets the packet TTL to 64 hops

max-user-port.name: Max User Port — 65534
max-user-port.description: Expands the available ports to 65534 (more simultaneous connections)

tcp-1323-opts.name: TCP Window Scaling — ON
tcp-1323-opts.description: Enables TCP Window Scaling (better throughput at high latency)

tcp-timed-wait-delay.name: TCP Timed Wait Delay — 30s
tcp-timed-wait-delay.description: Shortens the TIME_WAIT port wait to 30 seconds

network-throttling.name: Network Throttling Index — OFF
network-throttling.description: Removes the Windows network throttle limit

tcp-window-size.name: TCP Window Size — 65535
tcp-window-size.description: Raises the TCP window to 65535 bytes (better throughput)

global-max-tcp-window-size.name: Global Max TCP Window — 65535
global-max-tcp-window-size.description: Sets the global maximum TCP window to 65535 bytes

delivery-opt-off.name: Delivery Optimization (P2P) — OFF
delivery-opt-off.description: Disables P2P sharing of Windows updates

qos-reservable-bw.name: QoS Reservable Bandwidth — 0% (off)
qos-reservable-bw.description: Frees 100% of the network bandwidth (lifts the 20% QoS reservation)

ecn-capability.name: ECN — ON (both sides)
ecn-capability.description: Enables Explicit Congestion Notification (fewer packet drops)

fast-send-datagram-threshold.name: UDP Fast Path — 65536 bytes
fast-send-datagram-threshold.description: Raises the UDP fast path limit (less latency in games/VoIP)

disable-ipv6.name: IPv6 — OFF (all interfaces)
disable-ipv6.description: Disables IPv6 on all network interfaces
